name: Americana workwear
region: California, Nevada and the American West
summary: The hard-wearing dress of miners, railmen and farmers. An indigo denim overall or a duck canvas coat, with copper rivets at the stress points, built for price and long wear.

philosophy.core_thesis: Work dress earns its form by use. Each seam, pocket and rivet answers a failure that the worker met, and the garment looks better when it is old.
design_principles: Rivet each stress point: the pocket corners and the base of the fly.
Weave the cloth heavy: 400 to 600 g per square metre in denim, 500 g or more in duck.
Double-stitch the felled seams so that no seam opens under load.
Set the pocket where the hand falls: two on the chest, two at the hip, one for the rule.
Cut the bib or jacket with room to bend and reach, and size it by use, not by fashion.
Dye the warp in indigo and leave the weft white, so that the cloth fades along the wear.
Use brass or copper hardware that does not rust.
anti_patterns: A thin, soft cloth that tears at the knee
Decoration that does not serve use
A tight fit that limits the reach
A clean, sprayed-on fade that has no wear behind it

silhouette.shape: A straight, roomy garment. Bib overalls with a front pocket, a boxy chore coat with large patch pockets, and a straight leg that clears a boot.
silhouette.line: A straight shoulder, a wide sleeve, a short boxy body and a straight, uncut hem.
silhouette.fit: Loose in the seat, the thigh and the arm so that the worker can climb, kneel and lift; the garment shrinks on the first wash.
silhouette.proportion: Jacket to the top of the hip; trouser inseam 80 to 84 cm; roughly 1 to 1 chest to hip.
rules: Place a patch pocket with a bar tack on each side of the chest.
Cut a straight leg with a rise that lets the wearer bend.
Fix a metal button or a rivet at each stress point.
Add a hammer loop and a rule pocket on the trouser.
Keep the front closed with a row of metal buttons or a bib.

fabrics.rule: Choose a heavy cotton twill or plain weave: indigo denim for the trouser and the overall, duck or corduroy for the coat. The cloth must take hard wear and age well.

methods: copper rivet at each pocket corner
bar tack at each stress point
heavy cotton duck for the coat
chain-stitched hems on a loop-stitch machine
construction.closures: Brass or iron tack buttons, a button fly, and a metal buckle at the back of the waist.
construction.details: Pocket rivets of copper, an arcuate stitch on the pocket, a hammer loop, a rule pocket and a leather or paper patch at the waist.

surface.pattern: Plain indigo, a plain tan duck, and a hickory-style stripe; no print.
surface.gloss: Denim and duck at 1–6 GU, dry and flat; wear brings a slight polish at the knee and the seat.
surface.wear: Raw denim fades along the creases and the seams, and the shape of the wearer's pocket content shows through; the owner repairs with a patch.

palette.strategy: One working blue and one earth tone; the colour fades with use, so the first colour is dark.

processes: weaving of denim and duck on a loom
riveting and bar tacking on a machine
making.scale: Factory made in the thousand from the 1870s, sold by the dozen through general stores and company stores.
making.signs: Copper rivets at the stress points, a double-needle felled seam, a bar tack, and a cloth that fades along the wear.

pieces.form: Bib overalls with a chest pocket and a hammer loop
Boxy three-pocket work coat with a turn-down collar
Denim work jacket with a pleated front and a button cuff
Carpenter trousers with a hammer loop and a rule pocket

evidence.title: Riveted denim jeans with red tab

emotion.target_response: A plain, honest sense of labour and use: the wearer looks capable and unfussy.

use_cases: a period costume brief for the American West
an image prompt for a farm or rail scene
a study note on the origin of jeans
avoid_when: the brief is formal or evening dress
the brief wants a slim, stretch fit
the brief is a tech shell

modifiers.how: Swap the duck for flannel, cut a closer body and add a lined, notched collar.
Move to a lighter cotton and wool mix, add a windproof outer and a layered kit.

ornament_level.note: Work dress has almost no ornament; the stitch and the rivet are the only marks.
